sar.narrative: Who: customer C13487, holder of mastercard debit card C13487-K1, is the subject of this report. What: 3 online transactions totalling $439.61 were made on the card between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26 in billing region 191 and are not consistent with the cardholder's history. How: every suspicious transaction on this card came from one device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080), recorded as New for the account and behind an anonymous proxy. The same device profile transacted on 27 other cards in the same burst (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06650-K2, C06710-K1, C07472-K1, C08168-K1, C08972-K2, C09049-K1, C09195-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1). Individual amounts are ordinary and the bank's risk scores stayed low, so the activity is visible only by linking cards through the shared device. Why suspicious: one device working many unrelated card numbers, always as a new device behind an anonymous proxy, indicates a single actor using many compromised cards. The activity matches previously confirmed fraud cases (CC-3035, CC-2985, CC-2971). Assessment: fraud probability 0.92 from a calibrated model over the card's history and graph evidence; the bank's own risk score on the flagged transaction was 0.05. The card is to be blocked and reissued and 27 connected cards placed under monitoring; the case is recorded in the investigation graph for future analysts, and this report is filed because the activity meets the reporting threshold.
